verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a datacenter GPU accelerator with a supporting software stack (ROCm, SMI, Kubernetes operators). It is not a hosted service that issues API credentials, so scoped or least-privilege agent credentials are a category error for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any credential-issuance capability; GPU partitioning and SR-IOV are hardware isolation features, not API credential scoping.
